steps.name: Riveria, the Free Trade City
steps.objective: Go to "Riveria" and talk to Levi.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: You're here. Have you been well? I'm glad you seem unharmed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look well too, Levi. Since you're here, did you find traces of the enemy?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes. Please come this way. We should speak quietly.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The people we believe are connected to the magic stones are hiding somewhere in Riveria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why would they be here?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Let me give you a brief explanation. Riveria is the largest trading city on Freios.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Unlike other cities and towns, it is governed by citizens rather than nobles or a king. They form a city council and elect a mayor to lead them.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Perhaps that's why the atmosphere is freer than elsewhere. The buildings and roads are laid out freely too, and people from many regions come and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then they must be used to outsiders. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Hmm... There will be much to do, so we'll need to make various preparations.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Riveria's current situation is complicated. Many substantial tasks lie ahead.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Please speak to me again when you're ready. I'll catch up on my own work in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: You're ready. Then I'll explain. The trail of the Agasura discovered at the Dragon Emperor's Palace leads through Drulridge in Mirgandia and on to Riveria.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Our investigation found traces of them on Merin Island, near Riveria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An island? Then we should go there at once.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: We can't act rashly right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: There are several problems.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: First, Riveria's city hall has prohibited entry to the island. They say they can't issue permits during the civil conflict, but it's highly suspicious.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Something is clearly happening inside, and it feels as though they're trying to keep us from seeing it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should we do?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: After careful thought, I found people who can help. Many people in Riveria oppose the mayor.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: You may not know of them, but they're active under the name Revolutionary Army.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? That sounds strange. A revolutionary army...?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: They're suspicious of this too. They say it makes no sense for city hall to control access to an island where unusual creatures have been sighted.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The officials claim it's to prevent unnecessary accidents, but there are many reasons for suspicion.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So we've decided to cooperate with the revolutionaries who rose against Mayor Zekal's tyranny.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Just so you know, Her Majesty of Jiendia has entrusted this matter to me, so you needn't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then we should work with the revolutionaries opposing Riveria's city hall.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Sigh. It's complicated even to think about. The Agasura, the island, and Zekal at city hall all seem connected.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: We may even have to fight the regular troops guarding Zekal... but let's leave that for later.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: First, find someone named Rosia and hear what she has to say. She's a member of the Revolutionary Army too...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I've already told her about you, so she'll help you right away.

steps.name: The Road to Marin Island
steps.objective: Travel to "Marin Island" and deliver the <Revolutionary Army Insignia> to Alvis.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Who are you? Ah, the adventurer the Jiendia imperial investigator mentioned. Welcome to Riveria, the city that strives for freedom.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Since we've agreed to cooperate for our respective causes, I should explain things to you too.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: You've been asked to investigate Merin Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'd like to go there. How should I proceed?

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Leave right away. We've made arrangements so you can get there.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Once you're on the island, find a man named Alvis. Give him this document and explain the situation. He'll help you.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: All the information we're receiving has come from Alvis, who has been stationed there.

steps.name: Rulers of Marin Island
steps.objective: Defeat the [Red Rabbit Assault Troopers] and [Iron Shell Scouts], then report to Alvis.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Who are you? A token of the Revolutionary Army?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: They said they were sending someone to investigate the island. So it's you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've come.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: (Alvis nods after hearing %s's explanation.)

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: So that's what happened. The strange creatures you encountered are here too. Twin-headed ogres, dragons of fire and ice, armored boars...

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Creatures like those don't normally live here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what on earth...

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: They're unusual enough that I remember them clearly. I don't know why they appeared...

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: But when they showed up, the local creatures certainly suffered. I watched quietly from hiding, and something felt wrong.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Then everything suddenly went quiet. I wondered where they'd disappeared to. So they went all the way to Drulridge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means there must be somewhere nearby where those creatures could be staying...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know any suspicious places?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: A few. But I couldn't confirm anything. Plenty of creatures here hate humans and keep getting in my way, so investigating is difficult.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I'd like you to drive some of them off for now...

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: What do you say? Will you try?

steps.name: Securing an Area to Search
steps.objective: Defeat the [Red Rabbit Strikers] and [Iron Shell Raiders], then report to Alvis.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Excellent. You're a skilled adventurer. Better than I expected. I like that.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: But don't take things lightly. Plenty of enemies remain, so conserve your strength.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Draw their attention for me while I search a little more. I think there's something in the direction I explored, but it isn't easy to find.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Help me a little longer. Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know this island well, so that sounds like the best approach for now.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Good. It's rare to find someone so easy to work with. This is a pleasure.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I'll be quick. Until then, keep those troublemakers looking elsewhere.

steps.name: A Shocking Truth
steps.objective: Defeat [Frogman Warriors], [Deadly Spider Gladiators], [Jager], and [Elrian], then report to Alvis.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Wow. Watching from a distance, you're incredible. Herding them together and shaking them off like that... Oh, right. Do you know what I found?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you discover something?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Yes. A suspicious place. Though horrifying might be a better word than suspicious.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: There were strange monsters inside, and some seemed to be trying to get out.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Creatures... no, monsters that don't belong here. That may be the place we've been looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go. I need to check it... There's something I want to know...

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Be careful. It looked truly dangerous...

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: It's noisy outside... Someone seems to have arrived...

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: It can't be the Riverian government troops Zekal gathered, can it? They wouldn't deliberately make a scene.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Ban, what will you do?

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: If they're going to interfere, shouldn't we deal with them?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: The noise keeps growing. Whoever it is, they're no novice.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Well, that's convenient. Let's run one more test before we leave. With our magic stones...

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Haven't we already gathered all the data we need? We have more than enough compared with what he gave us.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: That's settled. But there are still some uncertain aspects to the stones' brainwashing ability.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Anyway, let's watch that and then leave. It shouldn't take long.

steps.name: Reporting the Situation
steps.objective: Go to "Riveria" and talk to Levi.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: (After hearing %s's account of what was found inside, Alvis is at a loss for words.)

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: People abducted and unknowingly used as materials for experiments on living bodies, and water spirits brainwashed by magic stones... Horrifying.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Mayor Zekal and those council members must have known that place existed. This is truly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We still need more information, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no way Riveria's mayor, who controls access to Merin Island, didn't know about that laboratory. He must be involved.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: What on earth is the mayor planning?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I thought Zekal kept doing strange things, but this crosses the line. No doubt about it. He's gone beyond that and meddled in things that should never be touched.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: %s, return and tell the revolutionaries and the person who sent you everything. I'll stay here and keep watch.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: ...Let's hope nothing else happens. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll head back. Be careful.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: A magic stone laboratory... Unbelievable. If this was happening on an island whose access the city blocked, then surely...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Mayor Zekal knew. There are a few things we need to check first.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: If we approach carelessly, they could turn the tables on us. Since you visited the laboratory, they probably know about you already.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So we need more evidence. Something absolutely conclusive...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Only then can we learn why the Agasura and Mayor Zekal are cooperating.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'll share this with Riveria's revolutionaries and discuss how to proceed. Meanwhile, please gather information on Zekal.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: He used to be a merchant, so Martelli should be a good person to ask. He's run a trading company in Riveria for a long time.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: And once this is over, you should be able to obtain the information you want too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... Understood.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Please don't worry too much. Her Majesty is working to keep her promise as well.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The revolutionaries know of your achievements, so you can go without drawing attention.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: You're here. I've been waiting. I heard you had questions about Zekal, so I'll tell you what I know.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: So much has happened...

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: He's the worst kind of man: incompetent and greedy. Hardly anyone would take his side...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's really that bad?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Yes, that bad. Anyway, let me continue. Zekal was born into the family of a great merchant and grew up wanting for nothing.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Then he inherited the trading company, and before long, it all went bankrupt.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: He was easily swayed and had no ability. He made so many bad decisions that the people around him abandoned him.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: And then a man like that suddenly became mayor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? How is that possible?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Even I wonder. Nobody could believe that the man whose incompetence bankrupted a trading company had become mayor.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: People were suspicious of Zekal. At some point, his behavior changed completely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it happened so suddenly, there must have been something behind it.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Hear me out first. He rebuilt his trading company and began amassing enormous wealth. People gathered around him, and he built a powerful faction.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: He gave large sums to the city council, ran for mayor, and was elected. Many opposed him, but the council pushed him through.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Then he began gathering troops in Riveria. He chose dictatorship, as if dreaming of becoming a king.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Thanks to him, Riveria is a complete mess now. It may have had problems before he became mayor, but never this bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are far too many suspicious details.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Also, at some point, a butler named Dit appeared at his side. A suspicious man of unknown origins. Zekal's actions sometimes changed according to his advice.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: That's everything I know. We're doing all we can to overcome the situation too...

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: So please do your best. I'll trust you.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: (Levi nods after hearing %s's account.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Just as Martelli said, there must be a reason for such a sudden change. For now, let's assume that reason was a contract with an Agasura.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don't know much about it, but I hear an Agasura's contract grants wishes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, though I don't know the limits of what it can grant...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Mayor Zekal's transformation, the magic stone laboratory on Merin Island, and a man dreaming of kingship... But do Agasura really have enough power to change a person so completely?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don't think that alone explains it.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The magic stones must have something to do with it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Agasura and magic stones...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: If we could discover why they created the stones, I think we'd have our answer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't understand...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I wish there were something more I could learn...)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Adventurer, let me introduce Eva, leader of the Revolutionary Army.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I think it would be best to discuss this together.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: So this is the adventurer Levi mentioned... I've heard much about you.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thanks to your efforts, the Revolutionary Army has been able to approach the truth.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: The connection between the magic stone laboratory, the Agasura, and Mayor Zekal...

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: It was deeply frustrating that we couldn't even uncover that.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: But thanks to you, we can act now. We've been able to gather our revolutionary forces in the meantime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's good.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you. At this moment, that's all I can say...

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what will you do now? May I offer a suggestion?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There may be documents in the mayor's residence. How about infiltrating it and looking for evidence?

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Yes. That is clearly the best course... but our Revolutionary Army has no one with those skills.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May I try?

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Would that be all right?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s has experience resolving many difficult situations. Even Her Majesty trusts this adventurer.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Of course, I've witnessed those achievements too, so I trust them as well. An excellent person...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for the praise. Then I'll do it.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you once again. I'm sorry to ask you to handle everything...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Meanwhile, we'll support you from the rear and make sure nothing else goes wrong.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Please make sure to collect useful evidence from city hall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Take care of yourself, adventurer.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Haha. I never expected to be defeated like this. You're skilled in combat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, that was close. What exactly are you...?

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: I'm the butler who assists Mayor Zekal. I thought it would be better for me to face you than for the mayor to do so himself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you one of those too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something created, like Geminus...

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: How foolish of you to compare me to that stupid ogre.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that means...

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Oh dear, a slip of the tongue. In that case, I think I know what happened to that foolish ogre.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: You're the one who ruined my master's plans. Hehe. How interesting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you planning? Answer me...

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Hehe. Thanks to you, I've bought some time.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Thank you for sparing it.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: It would be awkward for me to intervene now, so I should withdraw. Until next time. Assuming you're still alive by then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: (Before the words have fully left his mouth, Dit disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What? Where did he go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've been played.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: There really was only one intruder?

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: The army I worked so hard to build has been completely wiped out?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I've been spotted...

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Grr... You dare interfere with me? I won't let you get away with this. More importantly, how am I going to explain this to him...?

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Still no end to your excuses, Mayor.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Butler! You wretch!! Why are you only showing up now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The butler...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's definitely something about that butler too.)

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: It was entertaining to watch you, adventurer.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: I'm not here to fight you personally this time. I'll simply take care of my business and leave. Haha.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Mayor Zekal. Thank you for your efforts.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Though we did far more work. You have no idea how much trouble my master and I went through to make an incompetent fool into a mayor.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Still, it was worthwhile.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: It greatly benefited the master who took me in.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: And now I'll carry out my next order. I've been instructed to dispose of an object that has outlived its usefulness.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: D-dispose? Surely you don't mean me?

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Me? After all this? You intend to dispose of me? After everything I've done for you!!

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: I never enjoyed speaking with you, and once again you speak so vulgarly. Let's end this, Mayor Zekal.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Now, rampage to your heart's content for him. Forget that you're human, and show us the true depths of your desire.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Heh... Damn you, Ban... Urgh! What have you done to me...?

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: I swore my loyalty...

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: And you treat me like this... Cough! Cough!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ban? Who is that?

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Hehehe... An Agasura. Heh... Yes. I should never have trusted an Agasura.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: An Agasura that remains unharmed even after granting a wish...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, wait...

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: (It seems Zekal can no longer say anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An Agasura... So an Agasura was controlling people like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't understand... I just don't understand...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never seen an Agasura cause trouble on this scale...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris... Where is Iris...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Let's go back for now. I should return and sort out my thoughts...

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: (Eva is shocked to hear what happened at city hall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mayor Zekal suddenly turned into a monster, so I had no choice but to fight.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's all right. I was surprised by what happened to him, but I'm glad the matter was resolved more easily than expected.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Your efforts have saved Riveria.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: So the stories about your abilities were true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I made a mistake along the way and was discovered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should have been more careful...

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: I heard a story about you among the investigators.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: They say you're so strong that no enemies can be found anywhere you've passed through...

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: That sounds like an exaggerated rumor...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Well, isn't a good outcome what matters?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When you put it that way, I'll take it as a compliment.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Then let me explain what we've established.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Zekal has fallen, and we were able to find ledgers and records inside city hall.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: That should be useful to the Revolutionary Army... no, to the people who've worked so hard for Riveria.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you for all your efforts on our behalf...

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Even if you helped because our interests aligned, we will never forget what you've done.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: And we'll use this opportunity to make Riveria a good place to live again.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Once more, my sincere thanks to you and to the Jiendia Empire for your help.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I always feel this way, but even after an incident ends, there is still so much to do.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Adventurer, shall we bring this matter to a close here?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Please spare me a moment. There's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It concerns the magic stone laboratory.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Alvis discovered traces of suspicious people there, the ones we believe are the Agasura we're after.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? What kind of traces?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Near the place where you fought the water spirit... they found a hidden room.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Apparently, all sorts of experiments and research were conducted inside. It was truly horrifying.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: We intend to collect the traces left there and pursue them... No, we're already pursuing them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're really quick.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Speed and accuracy! That's the creed of the imperial investigation team. Hehe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hearing that makes me look forward to what comes next.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Of course. You should look forward to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Levi, for me...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Oh, Rosia is looking for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don't know what it's about either. You'll find out when you see her.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'll keep contacting you as soon as we have new information.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Until then, you should attend to other matters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No helping it. I suppose I'll wait for now.)

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: I'll give you information about the person you're looking for.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: (Rosia studies %s's face, then smiles broadly.)

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Levi first asked us whether we knew her. He said you were searching for her whereabouts...

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: I wanted to tell you personally. A girl named Iris did come to Riveria. Only briefly...

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Please listen calmly. She said she'd been trapped somewhere.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: A place with nothing in it but sorrow. She wanted to leave quickly, but couldn't. Then, by chance, she found a way out...

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: She said she came to her senses near Riveria. Someone like me can't understand exactly what she meant...

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: But when I later learned what Iris had been through, I realized how much she'd suffered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, then where did Iris go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When did all this happen?

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: So much time has passed already.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: It's been a year since Iris left.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: She would often say she had to go where Lady Seres was. But she hesitated, saying it wasn't time yet.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: According to legend, the goddess vanished to protect the world... Hmm. Perhaps Iris went there to pray?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By there, you mean...

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: There's an old temple in southern Freios. A temple belonging to the order that worships the ancient goddess Seres... Perhaps she went there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Rosia. You've been a great help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Seres... She spoke to me once... I'm sure... What did she say then? My memory...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't remember. But I can't stay here like this. Let's go to the temple first. I'll find out when I get there, won't I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait for me, Iris... I'll find you.
